dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical 2D geometric narrowing from the mid-body toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white with a subtle cool-grey tint likely induced by water depth and ambient light.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-density distribution of localized, elongated grey streaks running longitudinally across the dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse; characterized by soft gradient slopes between the mature white skin and faint grey pigmented marks.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Visible low-contrast linear rake marks distributed across the central dorsal plane.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of multiple faint, healed linear rake marks on the dorsal surface.
